results.name: Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight down and palms facing each other.
Hinge at the hips to lean forward, keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent. Your torso should be almost parallel to the floor.
Lift the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your shoulders. Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control and repeat.
tips: Focus on using your rear deltoids and upper back muscles to lift the weights.
Avoid swinging the weights or using momentum; aim for a controlled and smooth motion.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
instructions: Begin by lying chest-first on an incline bench, with your feet planted firmly on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging down, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to your sides until your arms are in line with your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, maintaining the slight bend in your elbows.
Repeat the exercise for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the bench to maintain stability.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Reverse Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Scott Press (360 Degree View)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your face, arms bent at 90 degrees, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Move the dumbbells outward in an arc motion, keeping your elbows bent and slightly raised, until your arms are extended to your sides just higher than shoulder height.
Bring the dumbbells back to the starting position in front of your face, maintaining the 90-degree bend in your elbows.
Repeat the arc motion for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
Focus on using your shoulder muscles to move the weights.
Avoid using excessive weights that compromise your form.
results.description: Dumbbell Scott Press (360 Degree View) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

Move the dumbbells outward in an arc motion, keeping your elbows bent and slightly raised, until your arms are extended to your sides just higher than shoulder height.
Bring the dumbbells back to the starting position in front of your face, maintaining the 90-degree bend in your elbows.
Repeat the arc motion for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
Focus on using your shoulder muscles to move the weights.
Avoid using excessive weights that compromise your form.
results.description: Dumbbell Scott Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Front Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Raise your right arm straight in front of you to shoulder height while rotating the dumbbell to face down, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Lower your right arm back to the starting position.
Repeat by alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you raise each dumbbell and inhale as you lower it.
Avoid swinging your body or using momentum; focus on controlled movements.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows to reduce strain on your joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Front Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight on the backrest and feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your face, arms bent at 90 degrees, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Press the right dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended, keeping your left dumbbell in place.
Lower the right dumbbell back to starting position and then press the left dumbbell overhead.
Continue to alternate arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
Use a weight that allows you to maintain proper form throughout the exercise.
Press the dumbbells in a controlled manner, avoiding any jerking movements.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, elbows facing outside, palms facing forward.
Press the right dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended, keeping your left dumbbell at shoulder level.
Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder level while simultaneously pressing the left dumbbell overhead.
Continue to alternate arms for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Press the dumbbells in a controlled manner, avoiding any jerking movements.
Keep your shoulders stable and avoid shrugging them during the press.
Focus on using your shoulder muscles to lift the weights, minimizing involvement from other muscles.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Shoulder Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Front Raise
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with your back on the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, allowing your arms to hang down by your sides. Your palms should face your thighs.
Begin the movement by raising both dumbbells in front of you, maintaining straight arms and rotating your palms to face down as the dumbbells rise.
Continue lifting until your arms are parallel to the floor and the dumbbells are at shoulder height.
Slowly and with control, lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, reversing the rotation of your palms to face your thighs again. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum; focus on slow and controlled movements.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce strain on your joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Front Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Let your arms hang down by your sides with your palms facing your body.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows as you lift both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, forming a "T" shape with your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid using momentum; lift and lower the weights in a controlled manner.
Do not lock your elbows; maintain a slight bend to protect your joints.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Close Grip Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight on the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, bringing them close in front of your face with your palms facing your head.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are extended overhead, maintaining a close grip throughout the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, keeping the weights close together. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back pressed firmly against the bench to avoid strain.
Choose a weight that allows you to maintain proper form and control.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the press; keep a slight bend to protect your joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Close Grip Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.
